question: Should the keyless Visual Crossing Timeline lane be its own record, with identity anonymous, next to data-apis/visual-crossing, whose identity is email?
why: The keyless lane needs no key, sign-up or card, is managed per client IP, publishes no allowance and caps a query at 48 records. The registered free account needs an email and carries 1,000 records a day and 1,000 records a query. A record holds one identity kind, so a filter on anonymous does not list the keyless lane. A draft for it was refused as the same offer as this record; a draft whose tier differs from this record's tier (free) is another offer, so a discover unit needs the vendor's label for the no-key lane as its tier.
